author: cairn
blurb: Search news articles and top headlines worldwide via NewsAPI. Requires a free API key.

definition.name: NewsAPI
definition.description: Search worldwide news articles and fetch top headlines by country or category via NewsAPI.org.

operations.name: search_news
operations.description: Search all news articles by keyword, newest first.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_news","description":"Search news articles by keyword.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"q":{"type":"string","description":"Search terms"},"language":{"type":"string","description":"2-letter language code, e.g. 'en'"},"pageSize":{"type":"number","description":"Results per page (max 100)"}},"required":["q"]}}

operations.name: top_headlines
operations.description: Get top breaking-news headlines for a country and/or category.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"top_headlines","description":"Get top news headlines.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"country":{"type":"string","description":"2-letter country code, e.g. 'us'"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["business","entertainment","general","health","science","sports","technology"],"description":"News category"},"pageSize":{"type":"number","description":"Results per page (max 100)"}},"required":[]}}
